• In February 2026, we announced positive topline data for INTEGUMENT-INFANT, a Phase 2 study evaluating the safety and efficacy of investigational ZORYVE cream 0.05% in infants as young as 3 months to less than 2 years of age with atopic dermatitis.

We submitted a supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) to the FDA based on the results of this trial to potentially expand the indication for ZORYVE cream 0.05% for the treatment of infants with atopic dermatitis down to the age of 3 months, which has been assigned a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of February 23, 2027.
